Perfect! Black is winning easily after Qc1+ Kg2 Qxc5, gaining the White queen. This is a **fork** — the queen on c1 gives check and attacks the undefended queen on c5. When White must move the king with Kg2, Black captures the queen with Qxc5.

**Coaching note:** When your opponent's queen is undefended, look for forcing checks that attack it simultaneously. Qc1+ is a classic royal fork—it gives check (forcing White's reply) while attacking the queen. After Kg2, the queen falls. Always scan for undefended pieces near checks.
